Note:
- Signed with the production Kuro Anime release certificate so it installs cleanly
  as an in-place upgrade over v1.5.3 / earlier 1.5.4-beta without wiping history.
- GitHub Releases and main branch remain on v1.5.3 (official public release).

What's Included in 1.5.4-beta:
1. Buttery-Smooth Native Scrolling & Clean Poster Pills:
   - Removed the top-right star rating badge from posters and kept only a smaller,
     compact SUB | DUB pill on the bottom-left.
   - Replaced live background glass-blur on poster pills and inline chips with
     crisp dark tinted pills (keeping glass blur only on the main top bar and
     pop-up menus).
   - Disabled mid-scroll poster/banner shifting so touch flings run directly at
     full screen smoothness while preserving the startup intro, tap animations,
     and page transitions.
   - Trimmed redundant background page scans, card re-checks, and catalogue batch
     calls when new rows load.

2. Signature Violet Default Theme Across the Entire App:
   - Signature Violet (#a65be4) is the default colour across all screens, splash,
     Settings accent preview, native dialogs, system bars, player controls, and
     Android TV banner, while keeping all 20 custom colours selectable in Settings.

3. Strong Performance & Compatibility Architecture:
   - Smart Encrypted DNS (DoH) unblock across Cloudflare (1.1.1.1/1.0.0.1), Google
     (8.8.8.8), and Quad9 (9.9.9.9) with automatic IPv4 + IPv6 fallback and pooled
     HTTP/2 connections across catalogue, posters, sources, and HLS playback.
   - Automatic ExoPlayer hardware-to-software video decoder fallback in both online
     and offline players.
   - Non-blocking background temporary cache scanner and 1-tap "Clear temporary
     stream cache" in Settings -> Network & compatibility.
   - Android TV / Fire TV Leanback launcher & banner support, foldable screen
     continuity, low-RAM cache trimming, and WebView crash-recovery shields.

4. Hardened Multi-Layer Player Ad Blocker + Android 15 Edge-to-Edge Window Fix.

5. Unified Account Hub (#3) + 24 Manga Face PFPs & Matching 16:9 Banners (art-11..34).
